claim: *The Controls Accumulate.* Project-specific lint files (definition validated against this chapter's snapshot counts), gate/check scripts (independent definition), and system-model files at each week's last commit. The four-snapshot growth curve of the earlier draft, resolved into a 29-week series: flat through week 8, a sharp takeoff at weeks 9–11, then cumulative growth decoupled from weekly realization volume.
topology: Quantitative axes preserve source values and categories.
bw_encoding: Explicit labels, distinct markers and monochrome patterns; no color-only distinction.
redesign: Line patterns and markers distinguish three stock series; missing observations omitted as in source. Restored external units and interpretive annotations at 10 pt.

style_review.fill: Explicit labels, distinct markers and monochrome patterns; no color-only distinction. Quantitative marks may use darker tones; text remains on white.
style_review.bold: Retained chart typography: values, axis/legend labels and callouts use regular text; series distinctions use marks/patterns rather than semantic weight.
style_review.routing: Quantitative positions, bars, line patterns and markers preserve the chart data; no process-edge routing is implied.
style_review.shape: Ordinary boxes use modest rounded corners; semantic document, state, decision, marker and quantitative shapes retain their roles.
style_review.visual_review: Native-size render inspected for contrast, typography, shape cues, annotation placement and routing.

typography_review.reason: Retained chart typography: values, axis/legend labels and callouts use regular text; series distinctions use marks/patterns rather than semantic weight.

evidence.source_style: regular Matplotlib glyph outlines; no Bold/Italic font glyphs in SVG

layout_review.reason: Retained generated chart/navigation: axis, legend or station spacing is clear; process-box alignment changes are not applicable.

page_layout.reason: Retain quantitative chart: existing axes, legends and explanatory labels are readable at native size; no height-constrained diagram prose.
